content:
Priya: Heads up — Azure EDP renewal call this Thurs. Need to lock in regional GPU floors and an explicit preemptible->reserved swap right. Also noticed weird credit deltas on last invoice, need to reconcile before we sign.

Ava: Agreed. We should ask for hard carveouts per region (us-west1/europe-west4) for p4/p5-equivalent and a fallback clause allowing non-preemptible replacement if preemptible capacity falls below X%.

Diego: Quick numbers — last invoice shows a ~12% delta between committed credits and applied credits, plus an unexplained $142k in disputed line items. Not signing anything until that's reconciled.

Eli: SRE note: whatever we get, we need availability targets on the reserved pools — 99.9% regional availability or credits. Also want a 72-hr ramp clause for capacity reconciliation.

Sam (azure-sales): We can propose a burst buffer and 72-hr ramp notice plus credits for sustained shortfall. The preemptible->reserved swap is possible but needs legal review; typically we handle with credits + guaranteed soft hold.

Priya: Can you confirm whether swap can include "capacity escrow" or a make-whole credit (not just future discount)? We prefer credits + additional reserved hours rather than discounts alone. Also please pull interruption history per zone.

Sam (azure-sales): I will check on escrow language and interruption telemetry. Also need a SKU-by-region usage table from you ASAP so we can size the floor properly.

BillingBot: Invoice digest — last_month_invoice_delta: -12.4% credits applied; disputed_charges: $142,300; top_regions_by_gpu_hours: us-west1, europe-west4, asia-southeast1. Detailed CSV uploaded to the billing bucket.

Diego: Attaching quick usage snapshot (rough, for sizing):
```
us-west1: 420000 GPU hours
eu-west4: 180000 GPU hours
asia-southeast1: 62000 GPU hours
commit_target: 650k GPU hours/month
```

Priya: Proposed negotiation asks (first pass):
1) Firm per-region floor covering 90% of our baseline by SKU family.
2) Make-whole credits if provider fails to deliver reserved capacity >3% of committed hours in a 30-day window.
3) Explicit preemptible->reserved swap option with credits + forced reserved hours within 72 hrs.
4) 90-day ramp protection (no overage penalties for first 90 days post-rollout).

Ava: Add right to cross-region failover for 30 days post-incident without overage penalty. Also require capacity planning cadence: weekly forecasts + ad-hoc surge requests.

Eli: Operational ask: weekly capacity reporting, interruption telemetry by zone, and a dedicated escalation path (pager + 4-hr response for reserved pool outages).

Sam (azure-sales): I'll compile this into a negotiation one-pager and loop in legal + capacity planning. Can the team produce the one-pager by EOD tomorrow? I can then book the internal review with our pricing team.

Priya: Yes — Diego/Ava, can you draft? I'll review and add SRE/finance notes.

Diego: :thumbsup: I'll draft cost models and worst-case exposure.

Ava: Will draft fallback clause language. Example snippet for legal:
```
If Provider fails to deliver reserved GPUs totaling more than X hours in any 30-day period, Provider shall credit 100% of missed committed hours at the committed rate and provide equivalent burst capacity within 72 hours.
```

Priya: Perfect. Ping me when it's up. Sam — please confirm whether interruption history and per-zone telemetry can be shared (we need at least 12 months).

Sam (azure-sales): On it — I should have telemetry + preliminary answers by tomorrow EOD. Will also flag the invoice dispute to the billing ops team. Thanks everyone.
